explanation: `right` is the midpoint of the bounding box. The self-intersecting outline is a bowtie whose two lobes meet at the centre, so that point is on the boundary, not inside. The click landed on empty canvas, which cleared the selection; pressing `j` with nothing selected correctly does nothing, so the test waited out its timeout on a notification that was never coming.
fix: `joinShapes` accepts a fraction of the bounding box so a concave outline can name a point inside itself, and each click asserts the selection took effect.
